seeds.ex: Control Hub is the single dashboard Cisco documents for managing users, permissions, calling, meetings, messaging, and devices. [cite:1] The first sign-in can start a setup wizard; accepting terms creates the organization, and the activation email address is the sign-in identity used to set the administrator password. Cited in this lab's ledger as retrieved 2026-10-14. The room marks part of this as re-check, so treat that part as unconfirmed.

Directory Connector runs on Windows Server 2025, 2022, 2019, or 2016, requires TLS 1.2 and .NET Framework 4.5, and needs Active Directory forest functional level 2 or higher. [cite:1] The connector sign-in account is the same user as a full administrator in Control Hub. Cited in this lab's ledger as retrieved 2026-10-14. The room marks part of this as re-check, so treat that part as unconfirmed.

Path for an organization template: Management > Users > Licenses, then Set up or Edit. Services listed in the wizard are Calling, Meetings, Messaging, and Contact Center. [cite:1] People can use the services when they become Active, which the article defines as the first sign-in to Webex. Cited in this lab's ledger as retrieved 2026-10-14. The room marks part of this as re-check, so treat that part as unconfirmed.

CSV create leaves Location ID blank. CSV edit does not change Location ID. Country in the CSV is the 2-letter code. [cite:1] Floors are a number plus an optional name, on the Floors tab. The workspace-locations API is the floor-capable endpoint. Cited in this lab's ledger as retrieved 2026-10-14.

Assign a person’s roles at Management > Users > the user > Summary > Administrator roles. Assign a group’s roles at Groups > Webex groups > the group > Assignments > Assign roles. [cite:1] User and device administrators can assign the location administrator role and cannot assign other administrator roles. Cited in this lab's ledger as retrieved 2026-10-14. The room marks part of this as re-check, so treat that part as unconfirmed.

Webex Calling troubleshooting is Monitoring → Troubleshooting. It keeps 21 days and shows segments, hops, and whether media used the cloud or ICE. [cite:1] Path optimization is ICE, PNC, or No optimization. A CSV holds 100 records from the tab you are on. [cite:1] Analytics keeps 3 months, or 13 with Pro Pack. Cited in this lab's ledger as retrieved 2026-10-14. The room marks part of this as re-check, so treat that part as unconfirmed.

Check Meetings, Messaging, and common application data at Account > Info > Data Locations. Check Contact Center at Contact Center > Settings > Service Details > Country of Operation. [cite:1] CountryCodeGEOMapping.xlsx maps a country to a region. On the User page tab, cell B3 is the country and cell B4 is the region. Cited in this lab's ledger as retrieved 2026-10-14. The room marks part of this as re-check, so treat that part as unconfirmed.

seeds.ti: Three AI names in Webex Contact Center
seeds.ex: nvvv1zb, header October 06, 2026, is the Cisco AI Assistant article: summaries, wellness, transcripts, Auto CSAT, topics, Real-time Assist, and sentiment. [cite:10] s0qro1 says you create agents in AI Agent Studio, then integrate them. Autonomous voice is limited to specific customers.

Prerequisites: the agent exists, the voice entry point exists, a flow is assigned, and the flow is set up. [cite:11] Scripted: Contact Center AI Config is Webex AI Agent Scripted, then a published scripted agent. [cite:11] Autonomous: Webex AI Agent Autonomous, then a published autonomous agent.

Set Global_Language to a language code such as fr-CA before the activity. [cite:11] Set Global_VoiceName to a voice code such as en-US-Jennifer. [cite:11] If the voice is not supported by the agent’s engine, the call exits the error path. [cite:11] State events use Event Name and Event Data.

seeds.ti: Digital AI agents and the six channels
seeds.ex: Webex Connect integration currently supports those six channels, header August 25, 2026. [cite:11] The AI Agent node has Process Message and Close session. [cite:11] onTimeOut is when the agent has not responded in not more than 15 seconds.

seeds.ti: What the public AI pages will not support
seeds.ex: Autonomous voice is not described as available to every customer. [cite:11] AI Quality Management’s getting-started FAQ says English only for now. That line is about quality management, not proof of the agent language list. [cite:6] n6gaghu is the third-party Virtual Agent–Voice article.

seeds.ti: A bridge is not a cutover
seeds.ex: In nbedetf, Webex Calling always means Webex Calling multi-tenant. [cite:14] Local Gateway is a bridge between the on-premises network and Webex Calling, for PSTN and for calling between Unified CM and cloud endpoints.

seeds.ti: Local Gateway as the calling bridge
seeds.ex: Local Gateway can be on premises or partner hosted. [cite:14] Named Cisco platforms: ISR 1100 and 4000, Catalyst 8200 and 8300, and Catalyst 8000V, plus certified third-party SBCs. [cite:14] It is for a phased migration as well as PSTN.

Supported solutions named: UCCX, UCCE, PCCE, Webex CCE, and Webex Contact Center. HCS Contact Center is out of scope. [cite:15] UCCX to the Unified CM it uses for call control needs round-trip time under 60 milliseconds. [cite:15] On-premises CCE and Webex CCE connect to Dedicated Instance with a SIP trunk.

seeds.ti: UCCX discovery into Webex Contact Center
seeds.ex: Prepare a WxCC tenant, Control Hub users, and contact-center synchronized users before the tool. [cite:16] The prose says download discovery tool v3.5. The printed jar command uses uccx-to-webexcc-v3.4.jar. Both strings are on the page.

seeds.ti: Other platforms, without a fake bridge
seeds.ex: nbedetf’s documented calling move is Unified CM to multi-tenant Webex Calling. [cite:14] 0hd75db’s documented contact-center move in this pass is UCCX to Webex Contact Center. [cite:16] n2puc5z moves Webex CCE admin data between tenants. It is not a foreign-platform importer.

Before the move, phones and Jabber register to Unified CM. Expressway-C and Expressway-E pairs serve MRA and business-to-business. CMS, CMM, and TMS are optional. Unity Connection is optional. [cite:1] After the move, Webex Calling is the cloud call service. Endpoint registration and call routing live there. Cited in this lab's ledger as retrieved 2026-10-14. The room marks part of this as re-check, so treat that part as unconfirmed.

Webex Calling documents three PSTN choices, selected per location: Cisco PSTN (Cisco Calling Plan), Cloud Connected PSTN, and premises-based PSTN (Local Gateway). You may mix them across locations. Each location has one. [cite:1] Local Gateway terminates a trunk on a supported session border controller. Cited in this lab's ledger as retrieved 2026-10-14. The room marks part of this as re-check, so treat that part as unconfirmed.

Internal extension length is 2–10 digits, default 4. Routing prefix length is 1–7 and includes the steering digit, so a length of 4 leaves 3 digits for the site. Lengthening extensions does not rewrite speed dials. [cite:1] If extensions repeat across locations, turn off extension dialing between locations. Cited in this lab's ledger as retrieved 2026-10-14.

MPP firmware 11.3.1 SR2 or later is required to enter an activation code on the phone. The phone reboots and onboards after the code is entered. [cite:1] CSV device type IP is for MPP, ATA, and DECT. WEBEX or WEBEX_CALLING is for RoomOS workspaces. The article’s example MAC is 001A2B3C4D5E. Cited in this lab's ledger as retrieved 2026-10-14.

When a hunt group or a call queue sends a call to an agent, that agent’s call forwarding does not apply. [cite:1] [cite:2] Hunt group busy is off by default. Only an administrator enables it, unless agents are allowed to use the FAC codes. Activation is #51, deactivation #52, interrogation #53. Cited in this lab's ledger as retrieved 2026-10-14. The room marks part of this as re-check, so treat that part as unconfirmed.

Secure SIP is TLS 1.2 or 1.3. Media suite in that article is AES_CM_128_HMAC_SHA1_80. [cite:1] Calling E2EE is off until you enable it, and recording turns it back off. [cite:2] The recording article names both Webex and Dubber as the default. [cite:3] WebRTC agents reach 911 through RedSky. Test with 933. [cite:5] Cited in this lab's ledger as retrieved 2026-10-14. The room marks part of this as re-check, so treat that part as unconfirmed.

Assign the service from Services > Calling > Managed Gateways. The hostname is the certificate FQDN. Devices register to the IPv4 address you enter. Download the template from Services > PSTN & Routing > Gateway configurations > Manage Gateways. Cited in this lab's ledger as retrieved 2026-10-14. The room marks part of this as re-check, so treat that part as unconfirmed.

The Calling analytics sentence is 13 months with Pro Pack and 3 months without, for calls based in Webex App. [cite:1] The January 27, 2026 picker change limits a selection to 3 months. History access is a separate sentence. [cite:1] Detailed Call History does not include the Call on Webex option. Cited in this lab's ledger as retrieved 2026-10-14.

Cisco’s architecture article calls Webex Contact Center a contact center as a service, built cloud-native: independent services, event-driven messaging, stateless services on Kubernetes, deployed in AWS. Cited in this lab's ledger as retrieved 2026-10-14. The room marks part of this as re-check, so treat that part as unconfirmed.

Partners should finish setup before they hand the account to a customer administrator. [cite:1] The customer path starts from the Welcome email’s Get Started link, then a password, then Terms of Service. [cite:1] The wizard at https://admin.webex.com/ keeps appearing until setup completes. Cited in this lab's ledger as retrieved 2026-10-14. The room marks part of this as re-check, so treat that part as unconfirmed.

An entry point is the ingress. Telephony maps it to a number. The flow is attached through a routing strategy. Messaging and social flows are chosen in Webex Connect. [cite:1] A routing strategy is a window: dates, 24-hour times, weekdays, a flow version, and an optional default flag. Cited in this lab's ledger as retrieved 2026-10-14.

Display larger than 500×500. Browser zoom 100%. One browser, one tab. Sign out from Idle, with no active conversation and no monitoring task. Desktop without browser permission, or a bad dial number, can RONA. If E911 was accepted and telephony still fails, share the Tracking ID. Cited in this lab's ledger as retrieved 2026-10-14. The room marks part of this as re-check, so treat that part as unconfirmed.

Cloud PSTN options in the article: Webex Contact Center PSTN, Cloud Connected PSTN, and Cisco Calling Plan for trials and supported service-number regions. [cite:1] On-premises PSTN is Local Gateway, over the internet or Webex Edge Connect. Cited in this lab's ledger as retrieved 2026-10-14. The room marks part of this as re-check, so treat that part as unconfirmed.

Connect and Engage are provisioned automatically. A new administrator must open Webex Connect within 7 days. [cite:1] Authorize the Webex CC Task and Webex CC Engage nodes before you build channels. [cite:1] Partner administrators do not have access to Webex Engage. Cited in this lab's ledger as retrieved 2026-10-14. The room marks part of this as re-check, so treat that part as unconfirmed.

Analyzer real-time reports stay up and default to a 5-second refresh (5–60). [cite:1] Historical Analyzer reports stay active 8 hours. [cite:1] The agent-statistics widget updates history every 24 hours and real-time every 60 seconds. [cite:2] Threshold alerts auto-refresh every 3 minutes. Cited in this lab's ledger as retrieved 2026-10-14. The room marks part of this as re-check, so treat that part as unconfirmed.

Personas: Supervisor plus Agent, Supervisor only, Licensed Administrator, Unlicensed Administrator. [cite:1] Minimum display is 500 by 500. The article recommends at least 1280 pixels wide. WebRTC is not available in VDI. [cite:1] Supervisor features are supported on the full desktop form factor, in a browser window. Cited in this lab's ledger as retrieved 2026-10-14. The room marks part of this as re-check, so treat that part as unconfirmed.

The Control Hub path is Services > Contact Center, then AI Features under Desktop Experience. [cite:1] Sentiment analysis requires real-time transcription on those queues, and flows that start transcription. [cite:1] Auto CSAT requires call recording for post-call processing. Cited in this lab's ledger as retrieved 2026-10-14. The room marks part of this as re-check, so treat that part as unconfirmed.

Dedicated Instance’s contact-center article calls Webex Contact Center Enterprise “a Cloud contact center for large enterprises” and points at a data sheet for details. [cite:1] The same article lists UCCX, UCCE, PCCE, Webex CCE, and WxCC as different deployment models. Cited in this lab's ledger as retrieved 2026-10-14. The room marks part of this as re-check, so treat that part as unconfirmed.

Unified CCE in this chapter integrates only with Unified CM. It was derived from Unified ICME. [cite:1] A Router plus Logger on one server is a Central Controller. [cite:1] PGs are duplex, but for many PG parts only one side is active. [cite:1] Direct CTI desktop use of GED-188 is deprecated in this chapter. Cited in this lab's ledger as retrieved 2026-10-14. The room marks part of this as re-check, so treat that part as unconfirmed.

Pre-routing comes from an IXC. Post-routing comes from the peripheral that already has the call. [cite:1] A route is a skill target plus a service. Every call to a peripheral needs a service. [cite:1] The routing client maps the label to busy, ring, an announcement, a scheduled target, or a trunk group and DNIS. Cited in this lab's ledger as retrieved 2026-10-14. The room marks part of this as re-check, so treat that part as unconfirmed.

Call Type Manager has a Script tab, a Period tab, and an optional Description. [cite:1] Run External Script, Play, Menu, Collect Data, or Queue before Send To VRU implies a Send To VRU for several VRU types. [cite:2] If Run External Script fails, test Call.VRUStatus. Cited in this lab's ledger as retrieved 2026-10-14. The room marks part of this as re-check, so treat that part as unconfirmed.

The VXML Server is a J2EE-compliant application server for dynamic VoiceXML applications. It can be installed without the Call Server. [cite:2] Standalone without reporting uses the VXML Server (Standalone) option. Standalone with reporting uses the VXML Server option and adds a Call Server and a Reporting Server. Cited in this lab's ledger as retrieved 2026-10-14. The room marks part of this as re-check, so treat that part as unconfirmed.

Finesse gadgets are applications inside one desktop. Third-party gadgets can live on the 3rdpartygadget web application or on an external server. [cite:1] REST calls from a gadget to an external service are proxied through Shindig. The gadget still has to authenticate to that third-party service itself. Cited in this lab's ledger as retrieved 2026-10-14. The room marks part of this as re-check, so treat that part as unconfirmed.

Transitional templates are the introductory stock set. All Fields templates expose database fields and are the base for custom reports, including precision-queue data. [cite:1] Import Outbound templates only when the deployment has Outbound Option. Cited in this lab's ledger as retrieved 2026-10-14. The room marks part of this as re-check, so treat that part as unconfirmed.

The private network carries synchronization and MDS traffic. The public network carries traffic between Central Controllers and PGs and is the alternate path that distinguishes a component failure from a network failure. Cited in this lab's ledger as retrieved 2026-10-14. The room marks part of this as re-check, so treat that part as unconfirmed.

Use the written Canon rooms for CVP, Finesse, CUIC, and sizing. Use this index to point the unwritten component, call-flow, and scripting topics at the chapter that already states them. [cite:1] [cite:2] The Router selects a peripheral or agent. The Logger stores configuration, real-time, and historical data. Cited in this lab's ledger as retrieved 2026-10-14. The room marks part of this as re-check, so treat that part as unconfirmed.

Equinix connectivity in the March 2022 note is a WAN to the Business Partner Network through ECX, in the U.S. and EMEA, with bandwidth from 200 MB to 10 GB. [cite:1] re-check VPN-less Finesse, same month, does not support FIPPA, and does not support multiple devices reaching the desktop through NAT. Cited in this lab's ledger as retrieved 2026-10-14. The room marks part of this as re-check, so treat that part as unconfirmed.

Knowledge Workers and Common Area devices captured in the First Time Setup Wizard determine how many call-processing nodes Cisco deploys. Sizing is a function of the Dedicated Instance team, not of the old on-premises cluster size. [cite:1] The first cluster in a region is activated within 48 hours. Cited in this lab's ledger as retrieved 2026-10-14. The room marks part of this as re-check, so treat that part as unconfirmed.

Dedicated Instance is an optional Webex Calling add-on. Activating a region is permanent, and the first voice service domain sticks. [cite:1] Activation deploys Unified CM, Unity Connection, Expressway Core and Edge, and Emergency Responder only in AMER. The access article also names IM and Presence and optional SME. Cited in this lab's ledger as retrieved 2026-10-14. The room marks part of this as re-check, so treat that part as unconfirmed.

Partner Connect addressing is a public /31 or /30 per physical link, four subnets per geo for Direct and four for Equinix Fabric, a public or private ASN, and a /16 per geo for partner management of the UC applications. Link subnets are not routed outside the service. Cited in this lab's ledger as retrieved 2026-10-14. The room marks part of this as re-check, so treat that part as unconfirmed.

R means the person doing the work. A signs off. C is two-way. I is one-way. [cite:1] Cisco is accountable and responsible for the core application build, core monitoring, and operational readiness testing before handover. [cite:1] A widespread issue is 100 percent of a UC cluster, or more than one cluster. Cited in this lab's ledger as retrieved 2026-10-14. The room marks part of this as re-check, so treat that part as unconfirmed.

If you need calls between the platforms, fold the preconfigured elements into both dial plans. [cite:1] Configure a PSTN connection on the default WXC-DI location before the main number. Until that number exists, users cannot make or receive calls through that route group. Cited in this lab's ledger as retrieved 2026-10-14. The room marks part of this as re-check, so treat that part as unconfirmed.

The practice article says roughly 95 percent of engineering effort is preparation and 5 percent is the change. That sentence is the article’s framing, not a sizing formula. [cite:1] The assistant tile is visible only when Setup Assist is enabled along with Dedicated Instance. Cited in this lab's ledger as retrieved 2026-10-14. The room marks part of this as re-check, so treat that part as unconfirmed.

Size trunks from concurrent calls. 2,000 seats is not 2,000 calls. [cite:2] Do not import ICM scripts. The crosswalk stays marked in T6-R04. [cite:4] Premises users cannot use cloud PSTN. [cite:3] WebRTC agents do not go live before 933. [cite:7] The runbook below is Canon planning. Cited in this lab's ledger as retrieved 2026-10-14.

The introduction says not to lift-and-shift Unified CM. Redefine requirements. The method is PPDIO: Prepare, Plan, Design, Implement, Optimize. [cite:1] Choose flash-cut or phased. Flash-cut moves everyone at once. The guides spend their detail on phased, because groups of users sit on both platforms during the move. Cited in this lab's ledger as retrieved 2026-10-14.

Migration Insights can run from any organization. You do not need the destination customer org to upload a Unified CM tar. [cite:2] Use SharedlineGroupMigrationReport.csv and HuntGroup_CallQueue_CallPark_CallPickUpGroups.csv to see who must move together. Cited in this lab's ledger as retrieved 2026-10-14. The room marks part of this as re-check, so treat that part as unconfirmed.

seeds.ti: UCCE and PCCE to Webex Contact Center
seeds.ex: Unified CCX has a discovery tool. The article says to download discovery tool v3.5, and the printed command runs uccx-to-webexcc-v3.4.jar . It writes WebexCC_Bulk_Upload.xlsx and a prompts zip. Bulk Operations in Control Hub imports the CSVs. The tool needs access to a Unified CCX server. Cited in this lab's ledger as retrieved 2026-10-14.

Migration Insights reads a Unified CM tar. A third-party PBX export is not that tar. [cite:2] [cite:5] The implement article says to work with the third-party vendor for third-party devices and phones. Cited in this lab's ledger as retrieved 2026-10-14. The room marks part of this as re-check, so treat that part as unconfirmed.

Slamming is forbidden. Cisco does not change a telephony provider without written consent of the authorized account holder. [cite:1] Same-account numbers port together even across orders. Distinct account information means separate orders. Toll-free is a separate order from DID, and the guidelines say US or CA only. Cited in this lab's ledger as retrieved 2026-10-14. The room marks part of this as re-check, so treat that part as unconfirmed.

A phased move splits users across Unified CM and Webex Calling. Each batch needs dial-plan updates on both platforms and on the Local Gateway. [cite:1] Put Webex Calling +E.164 patterns in their own partition. Cited in this lab's ledger as retrieved 2026-10-14. The room marks part of this as re-check, so treat that part as unconfirmed.

On-net tests cover transfer, hold, forwarding, and conferencing. PSTN tests cover inbound to users, queues, hunts, and auto attendants, plus outbound caller ID. [cite:1] Hunt tests check the configured algorithm, overflow, forwarding, no-answer, and that membership and routing match what was on Unified CM. Cited in this lab's ledger as retrieved 2026-10-14. The room marks part of this as re-check, so treat that part as unconfirmed.

The trunk to Webex Calling is SIP over TLS. Media is SRTP. Commercial gateways offer AES_CM_128_HMAC_SHA1_80. [cite:1] Registration trunks are CUBE only and stop at 250 calls. Certificate trunks go past 250 and need OPTIONS from the gateway FQDN. Cited in this lab's ledger as retrieved 2026-10-14.

jr1i3r’s voice class codec 100 allows G.711 only: preference 1 g711ulaw, preference 2 g711alaw. Add another codec only when both sides support it. DSP transcoding is supported and is not in that guide. Cited in this lab's ledger as retrieved 2026-10-14.

Media optimization uses ICE. Desk phones except DECT and ATA, the Webex App, and Local Gateway are the supported set. It is on by default for desk phones and the Webex App. [cite:1] Local Gateway uses ICE-lite. Minimum CUBE software in that article is 17.3 or 16.12.5. Cited in this lab's ledger as retrieved 2026-10-14. The room marks part of this as re-check, so treat that part as unconfirmed.

A route group holds at least one trunk and at most ten. Same priority is random load balancing. A lower priority is used when the higher-priority trunks are unavailable. [cite:1] Trunk status is online, offline, impaired, or unknown. The page updates every 3 minutes. Cited in this lab's ledger as retrieved 2026-10-14.

Skill-based selection filters agents who entirely satisfy the contact or the queue, then applies the pattern. Weights change Best Available scoring. They do not change Longest Available. [cite:1] Non-skill Longest Available picks the agent available longest since their last contact. Cited in this lab's ledger as retrieved 2026-10-14.

upg0eu, dated August 30, 2024, compares Auto Attendant, Call Queue, Hunt Group, and Shared Line Group. Only the call queue adds callers to a queue. Only the auto attendant provides IVR. A call queue and a hunt group say an auto attendant can be used as the IVR. Cited in this lab's ledger as retrieved 2026-10-14. The room marks part of this as re-check, so treat that part as unconfirmed.

A dial plan is global for the enterprise. It chooses a trunk or a route group for matching patterns, for every user, regardless of location. [cite:1] If the caller is still a premises user, stop. Cloud PSTN will not take that call. Give them a premises path or move the user. Cited in this lab's ledger as retrieved 2026-10-14.

Flow Designer routes real-time calls. You choose activities, including how agents are assigned, from a drag-and-drop library. [cite:1] Start Flow is already on the main canvas. You cannot delete it. It is the event that triggers the flow. [cite:1] Validation is off by default, so errors stay hidden. Cited in this lab's ledger as retrieved 2026-10-14.

Courtesy callback creates a queue task. Keep the original queue if the contact should hold its place. Move it only when you accept the end of the new queue, no skills, and default priority. [cite:2] Scheduled callback is a future window. Configure the Callback Default Entry Point first. Cited in this lab's ledger as retrieved 2026-10-14.

Connect’s own page lists six areas: channel provisioning, integration setup, flow orchestration, multichannel messaging, NLP/NLU/AI, and enterprise control. Channels include SMS, RCS, Branded Text, WhatsApp, Push, Live Chat and In-App, Email, Voice, MMS, Apple Messages for Business, and Messenger. Cited in this lab's ledger as retrieved 2026-10-14.

Each connector launches Desktop inside the CRM. You do not create a new Webex App for the install. [cite:1] [cite:2] [cite:3] Chat and email stay on Connect and the digital desktop. The connector articles say those channels are unsupported here, for every CRM that uses these connectors. Cited in this lab's ledger as retrieved 2026-10-14.

AI Assistant is a paid desktop add-on with an icon. Header on nvvv1zb: October 06, 2026. [cite:1] Scripted and autonomous agents are built in AI Agent Studio and attached with Virtual Agent V2 or the Connect AI Agent node. [cite:2] [cite:3] Autonomous voice is limited to specific customers. Cited in this lab's ledger as retrieved 2026-10-14.

The troubleshooting view needs the full admin, read-only admin, or support admin role. It shows calls for the past 21 days. Calls appear after the call ends. [cite:1] Search keys are email addresses, phone numbers, MAC addresses, call IDs, and correlation IDs. Status is Successful, Refusal, or Failure. Cited in this lab's ledger as retrieved 2026-10-14.

You can export up to 100 troubleshooting call records per CSV file. From the call details page you can also download a JSON call report and participant details as CSV. [cite:1] n4hssfr, dated July 01, 2025: an administrator can start a PRT from a Webex Calling MPP phone that is actively registered. Cited in this lab's ledger as retrieved 2026-10-14. The room marks part of this as re-check, so treat that part as unconfirmed.

Webex Calling what’s new, header October 13, 2026: on October 13, DECT network logging is Standard or Debug. On October 7, toll-free and non-geographic numbers were listed for twelve countries. [cite:1] g1gtsdb, header October 07, 2026: non-geographic numbers are not supported with Cisco Calling Plans. Cited in this lab's ledger as retrieved 2026-10-14.

seeds.ti: Workforce and quality, in plain words
seeds.ex: Wikipedia describes workforce management as forecasting and scheduling, plus performance, training, and budgeting, usually with software rather than only a spreadsheet. [cite:1] The same encyclopedia describes a call centre as an office dealing with a large volume of enquiries by telephone.

seeds.ti: Basic workforce management on Webex WFO
seeds.ex: Basic WFM forecasts voice, digital, and back-office demand. [cite:3] Agents use MyTime on web and mobile, and they can bid for shifts under pre-defined rules. [cite:3] Supervisors get scheduling and editing, intraday dashboards, and real-time adherence in the basic feature list.

Basic QM includes call recording, evaluation across voice and digital, search and playback, text search, screen recording, and evaluation forms. [cite:3] Existing QM adds insights reporting, workflows, custom metadata, live screen monitoring, calibration, appeals, and HR or training tagging.

seeds.ti: AI Quality Management in Control Hub
seeds.ex: Required SKUs printed on both articles: A-FLEX-AI-QM, or the bundle A-FLEX-AI-QMMB. [cite:5] [cite:6] Features can be organization, queue, or agent scoped. [cite:5] The getting-started page lists automated evaluations, sentiment, coaching insights, an agent performance dashboard, and Analyzer reports.

Two custom report types: interaction-level QM metrics (CSR) and agent performance by team (ASR). [cite:7] Customer Sentiment Score runs from -100 to +100. Above +45 is positive, below -45 is negative, and the band between is neutral.

Locations & Sites. CSV create leaves Location ID blank. CSV edit does not change Location ID. Country in the CSV is the 2-letter code. [cite:1] Floors are a number plus an optional name, on the Floors tab. The workspace-locations API is the floor-capable endpoint. Cited in this lab's ledger as retrieved 2026-10-14.

Admin Roles & Partner Admin. Assign a person’s roles at Management > Users > the user > Summary > Administrator roles. Assign a group’s roles at Groups > Webex groups > the group > Assignments > Assign roles. Cited in this lab's ledger as retrieved 2026-10-14. The room marks part of this as re-check, so treat that part as unconfirmed.

Analytics & Troubleshooting Views. Webex Calling troubleshooting is Monitoring → Troubleshooting. It keeps 21 days and shows segments, hops, and whether media used the cloud or ICE. [cite:1] Path optimization is ICE, PNC, or No optimization. A CSV holds 100 records from the tab you are on. Cited in this lab's ledger as retrieved 2026-10-14. The room marks part of this as re-check, so treat that part as unconfirmed.

Local Gateway & PSTN Options. Webex Calling documents three PSTN choices, selected per location: Cisco PSTN (Cisco Calling Plan), Cloud Connected PSTN, and premises-based PSTN (Local Gateway). You may mix them across locations. Each location has one. Cited in this lab's ledger as retrieved 2026-10-14. The room marks part of this as re-check, so treat that part as unconfirmed.

Call Features. When a hunt group or a call queue sends a call to an agent, that agent’s call forwarding does not apply. [cite:1] [cite:2] Hunt group busy is off by default. Only an administrator enables it, unless agents are allowed to use the FAC codes. Cited in this lab's ledger as retrieved 2026-10-14. The room marks part of this as re-check, so treat that part as unconfirmed.

Entry Points, Queues & Routing Strategies. An entry point is the ingress. Telephony maps it to a number. The flow is attached through a routing strategy. Messaging and social flows are chosen in Webex Connect. Cited in this lab's ledger as retrieved 2026-10-14.

Agent Desktop & Supervisor. Display larger than 500×500. Browser zoom 100%. One browser, one tab. Sign out from Idle, with no active conversation and no monitoring task. Desktop without browser permission, or a bad dial number, can RONA. Cited in this lab's ledger as retrieved 2026-10-14.

Analyzer & Reporting. Analyzer real-time reports stay up and default to a 5-second refresh (5–60). [cite:1] Historical Analyzer reports stay active 8 hours. [cite:1] The agent-statistics widget updates history every 24 hours and real-time every 60 seconds. Cited in this lab's ledger as retrieved 2026-10-14. The room marks part of this as re-check, so treat that part as unconfirmed.

Scripting & ICM Routing. Call Type Manager has a Script tab, a Period tab, and an optional Description. [cite:1] Run External Script, Play, Menu, Collect Data, or Queue before Send To VRU implies a Send To VRU for several VRU types. [cite:2] If Run External Script fails, test Call.VRUStatus. Cited in this lab's ledger as retrieved 2026-10-14. The room marks part of this as re-check, so treat that part as unconfirmed.

Finesse Desktop & Gadgets. Finesse gadgets are applications inside one desktop. Third-party gadgets can live on the 3rdpartygadget web application or on an external server. [cite:1] REST calls from a gadget to an external service are proxied through Shindig. Cited in this lab's ledger as retrieved 2026-10-14. The room marks part of this as re-check, so treat that part as unconfirmed.

What Dedicated Instance Is. Knowledge Workers and Common Area devices captured in the First Time Setup Wizard determine how many call-processing nodes Cisco deploys. Sizing is a function of the Dedicated Instance team, not of the old on-premises cluster size. Cited in this lab's ledger as retrieved 2026-10-14. The room marks part of this as re-check, so treat that part as unconfirmed.

DI Architecture & Peering. Dedicated Instance is an optional Webex Calling add-on. Activating a region is permanent, and the first voice service domain sticks. [cite:1] Activation deploys Unified CM, Unity Connection, Expressway Core and Edge, and Emergency Responder only in AMER. Cited in this lab's ledger as retrieved 2026-10-14.

CUCM to Webex Calling. The introduction says not to lift-and-shift Unified CM. Redefine requirements. The method is PPDIO: Prepare, Plan, Design, Implement, Optimize. [cite:1] Choose flash-cut or phased. Flash-cut moves everyone at once. Cited in this lab's ledger as retrieved 2026-10-14.

SIP Fundamentals for Webex. The trunk to Webex Calling is SIP over TLS. Media is SRTP. Commercial gateways offer AES_CM_128_HMAC_SHA1_80. [cite:1] Registration trunks are CUBE only and stop at 250 calls. Certificate trunks go past 250 and need OPTIONS from the gateway FQDN. Cited in this lab's ledger as retrieved 2026-10-14.

docs.ex: Control Hub is the single dashboard Cisco documents for managing users, permissions, calling, meetings, messaging, and devices. [cite:1] The first sign-in can start a setup wizard; accepting terms creates the organization, and the activation email address is the sign-in identity used to set the administrator password. Cited in this lab's ledger as retrieved 2026-10-14. The room marks part of this as re-check, so treat that part as unconfirmed.

Directory Connector runs on Windows Server 2025, 2022, 2019, or 2016, requires TLS 1.2 and .NET Framework 4.5, and needs Active Directory forest functional level 2 or higher. [cite:1] The connector sign-in account is the same user as a full administrator in Control Hub. Cited in this lab's ledger as retrieved 2026-10-14. The room marks part of this as re-check, so treat that part as unconfirmed.

Path for an organization template: Management > Users > Licenses, then Set up or Edit. Services listed in the wizard are Calling, Meetings, Messaging, and Contact Center. [cite:1] People can use the services when they become Active, which the article defines as the first sign-in to Webex. Cited in this lab's ledger as retrieved 2026-10-14. The room marks part of this as re-check, so treat that part as unconfirmed.

CSV create leaves Location ID blank. CSV edit does not change Location ID. Country in the CSV is the 2-letter code. [cite:1] Floors are a number plus an optional name, on the Floors tab. The workspace-locations API is the floor-capable endpoint. Cited in this lab's ledger as retrieved 2026-10-14.

Assign a person’s roles at Management > Users > the user > Summary > Administrator roles. Assign a group’s roles at Groups > Webex groups > the group > Assignments > Assign roles. [cite:1] User and device administrators can assign the location administrator role and cannot assign other administrator roles. Cited in this lab's ledger as retrieved 2026-10-14. The room marks part of this as re-check, so treat that part as unconfirmed.

Webex Calling troubleshooting is Monitoring → Troubleshooting. It keeps 21 days and shows segments, hops, and whether media used the cloud or ICE. [cite:1] Path optimization is ICE, PNC, or No optimization. A CSV holds 100 records from the tab you are on. [cite:1] Analytics keeps 3 months, or 13 with Pro Pack. Cited in this lab's ledger as retrieved 2026-10-14. The room marks part of this as re-check, so treat that part as unconfirmed.

Check Meetings, Messaging, and common application data at Account > Info > Data Locations. Check Contact Center at Contact Center > Settings > Service Details > Country of Operation. [cite:1] CountryCodeGEOMapping.xlsx maps a country to a region. On the User page tab, cell B3 is the country and cell B4 is the region. Cited in this lab's ledger as retrieved 2026-10-14. The room marks part of this as re-check, so treat that part as unconfirmed.

docs.ti: Three AI names in Webex Contact Center
docs.ex: nvvv1zb, header October 06, 2026, is the Cisco AI Assistant article: summaries, wellness, transcripts, Auto CSAT, topics, Real-time Assist, and sentiment. [cite:10] s0qro1 says you create agents in AI Agent Studio, then integrate them. Autonomous voice is limited to specific customers.

Prerequisites: the agent exists, the voice entry point exists, a flow is assigned, and the flow is set up. [cite:11] Scripted: Contact Center AI Config is Webex AI Agent Scripted, then a published scripted agent. [cite:11] Autonomous: Webex AI Agent Autonomous, then a published autonomous agent.

Set Global_Language to a language code such as fr-CA before the activity. [cite:11] Set Global_VoiceName to a voice code such as en-US-Jennifer. [cite:11] If the voice is not supported by the agent’s engine, the call exits the error path. [cite:11] State events use Event Name and Event Data.

docs.ti: Digital AI agents and the six channels
docs.ex: Webex Connect integration currently supports those six channels, header August 25, 2026. [cite:11] The AI Agent node has Process Message and Close session. [cite:11] onTimeOut is when the agent has not responded in not more than 15 seconds.

docs.ti: What the public AI pages will not support
docs.ex: Autonomous voice is not described as available to every customer. [cite:11] AI Quality Management’s getting-started FAQ says English only for now. That line is about quality management, not proof of the agent language list. [cite:6] n6gaghu is the third-party Virtual Agent–Voice article.

docs.ti: A bridge is not a cutover
docs.ex: In nbedetf, Webex Calling always means Webex Calling multi-tenant. [cite:14] Local Gateway is a bridge between the on-premises network and Webex Calling, for PSTN and for calling between Unified CM and cloud endpoints.

docs.ti: Local Gateway as the calling bridge
docs.ex: Local Gateway can be on premises or partner hosted. [cite:14] Named Cisco platforms: ISR 1100 and 4000, Catalyst 8200 and 8300, and Catalyst 8000V, plus certified third-party SBCs. [cite:14] It is for a phased migration as well as PSTN.

Supported solutions named: UCCX, UCCE, PCCE, Webex CCE, and Webex Contact Center. HCS Contact Center is out of scope. [cite:15] UCCX to the Unified CM it uses for call control needs round-trip time under 60 milliseconds. [cite:15] On-premises CCE and Webex CCE connect to Dedicated Instance with a SIP trunk.

docs.ti: UCCX discovery into Webex Contact Center
docs.ex: Prepare a WxCC tenant, Control Hub users, and contact-center synchronized users before the tool. [cite:16] The prose says download discovery tool v3.5. The printed jar command uses uccx-to-webexcc-v3.4.jar. Both strings are on the page.

docs.ti: Other platforms, without a fake bridge
docs.ex: nbedetf’s documented calling move is Unified CM to multi-tenant Webex Calling. [cite:14] 0hd75db’s documented contact-center move in this pass is UCCX to Webex Contact Center. [cite:16] n2puc5z moves Webex CCE admin data between tenants. It is not a foreign-platform importer.

Before the move, phones and Jabber register to Unified CM. Expressway-C and Expressway-E pairs serve MRA and business-to-business. CMS, CMM, and TMS are optional. Unity Connection is optional. [cite:1] After the move, Webex Calling is the cloud call service. Endpoint registration and call routing live there. Cited in this lab's ledger as retrieved 2026-10-14. The room marks part of this as re-check, so treat that part as unconfirmed.

Webex Calling documents three PSTN choices, selected per location: Cisco PSTN (Cisco Calling Plan), Cloud Connected PSTN, and premises-based PSTN (Local Gateway). You may mix them across locations. Each location has one. [cite:1] Local Gateway terminates a trunk on a supported session border controller. Cited in this lab's ledger as retrieved 2026-10-14. The room marks part of this as re-check, so treat that part as unconfirmed.

Internal extension length is 2–10 digits, default 4. Routing prefix length is 1–7 and includes the steering digit, so a length of 4 leaves 3 digits for the site. Lengthening extensions does not rewrite speed dials. [cite:1] If extensions repeat across locations, turn off extension dialing between locations. Cited in this lab's ledger as retrieved 2026-10-14.

MPP firmware 11.3.1 SR2 or later is required to enter an activation code on the phone. The phone reboots and onboards after the code is entered. [cite:1] CSV device type IP is for MPP, ATA, and DECT. WEBEX or WEBEX_CALLING is for RoomOS workspaces. The article’s example MAC is 001A2B3C4D5E. Cited in this lab's ledger as retrieved 2026-10-14.

When a hunt group or a call queue sends a call to an agent, that agent’s call forwarding does not apply. [cite:1] [cite:2] Hunt group busy is off by default. Only an administrator enables it, unless agents are allowed to use the FAC codes. Activation is #51, deactivation #52, interrogation #53. Cited in this lab's ledger as retrieved 2026-10-14. The room marks part of this as re-check, so treat that part as unconfirmed.

Secure SIP is TLS 1.2 or 1.3. Media suite in that article is AES_CM_128_HMAC_SHA1_80. [cite:1] Calling E2EE is off until you enable it, and recording turns it back off. [cite:2] The recording article names both Webex and Dubber as the default. [cite:3] WebRTC agents reach 911 through RedSky. Test with 933. [cite:5] Cited in this lab's ledger as retrieved 2026-10-14. The room marks part of this as re-check, so treat that part as unconfirmed.

Assign the service from Services > Calling > Managed Gateways. The hostname is the certificate FQDN. Devices register to the IPv4 address you enter. Download the template from Services > PSTN & Routing > Gateway configurations > Manage Gateways. Cited in this lab's ledger as retrieved 2026-10-14. The room marks part of this as re-check, so treat that part as unconfirmed.

The Calling analytics sentence is 13 months with Pro Pack and 3 months without, for calls based in Webex App. [cite:1] The January 27, 2026 picker change limits a selection to 3 months. History access is a separate sentence. [cite:1] Detailed Call History does not include the Call on Webex option. Cited in this lab's ledger as retrieved 2026-10-14.

Cisco’s architecture article calls Webex Contact Center a contact center as a service, built cloud-native: independent services, event-driven messaging, stateless services on Kubernetes, deployed in AWS. Cited in this lab's ledger as retrieved 2026-10-14. The room marks part of this as re-check, so treat that part as unconfirmed.

Partners should finish setup before they hand the account to a customer administrator. [cite:1] The customer path starts from the Welcome email’s Get Started link, then a password, then Terms of Service. [cite:1] The wizard at https://admin.webex.com/ keeps appearing until setup completes. Cited in this lab's ledger as retrieved 2026-10-14. The room marks part of this as re-check, so treat that part as unconfirmed.

An entry point is the ingress. Telephony maps it to a number. The flow is attached through a routing strategy. Messaging and social flows are chosen in Webex Connect. [cite:1] A routing strategy is a window: dates, 24-hour times, weekdays, a flow version, and an optional default flag. Cited in this lab's ledger as retrieved 2026-10-14.

Display larger than 500×500. Browser zoom 100%. One browser, one tab. Sign out from Idle, with no active conversation and no monitoring task. Desktop without browser permission, or a bad dial number, can RONA. If E911 was accepted and telephony still fails, share the Tracking ID. Cited in this lab's ledger as retrieved 2026-10-14. The room marks part of this as re-check, so treat that part as unconfirmed.

Cloud PSTN options in the article: Webex Contact Center PSTN, Cloud Connected PSTN, and Cisco Calling Plan for trials and supported service-number regions. [cite:1] On-premises PSTN is Local Gateway, over the internet or Webex Edge Connect. Cited in this lab's ledger as retrieved 2026-10-14. The room marks part of this as re-check, so treat that part as unconfirmed.

Connect and Engage are provisioned automatically. A new administrator must open Webex Connect within 7 days. [cite:1] Authorize the Webex CC Task and Webex CC Engage nodes before you build channels. [cite:1] Partner administrators do not have access to Webex Engage. Cited in this lab's ledger as retrieved 2026-10-14. The room marks part of this as re-check, so treat that part as unconfirmed.

Analyzer real-time reports stay up and default to a 5-second refresh (5–60). [cite:1] Historical Analyzer reports stay active 8 hours. [cite:1] The agent-statistics widget updates history every 24 hours and real-time every 60 seconds. [cite:2] Threshold alerts auto-refresh every 3 minutes. Cited in this lab's ledger as retrieved 2026-10-14. The room marks part of this as re-check, so treat that part as unconfirmed.

Personas: Supervisor plus Agent, Supervisor only, Licensed Administrator, Unlicensed Administrator. [cite:1] Minimum display is 500 by 500. The article recommends at least 1280 pixels wide. WebRTC is not available in VDI. [cite:1] Supervisor features are supported on the full desktop form factor, in a browser window. Cited in this lab's ledger as retrieved 2026-10-14. The room marks part of this as re-check, so treat that part as unconfirmed.

The Control Hub path is Services > Contact Center, then AI Features under Desktop Experience. [cite:1] Sentiment analysis requires real-time transcription on those queues, and flows that start transcription. [cite:1] Auto CSAT requires call recording for post-call processing. Cited in this lab's ledger as retrieved 2026-10-14. The room marks part of this as re-check, so treat that part as unconfirmed.

Dedicated Instance’s contact-center article calls Webex Contact Center Enterprise “a Cloud contact center for large enterprises” and points at a data sheet for details. [cite:1] The same article lists UCCX, UCCE, PCCE, Webex CCE, and WxCC as different deployment models. Cited in this lab's ledger as retrieved 2026-10-14. The room marks part of this as re-check, so treat that part as unconfirmed.

Unified CCE in this chapter integrates only with Unified CM. It was derived from Unified ICME. [cite:1] A Router plus Logger on one server is a Central Controller. [cite:1] PGs are duplex, but for many PG parts only one side is active. [cite:1] Direct CTI desktop use of GED-188 is deprecated in this chapter. Cited in this lab's ledger as retrieved 2026-10-14. The room marks part of this as re-check, so treat that part as unconfirmed.

Pre-routing comes from an IXC. Post-routing comes from the peripheral that already has the call. [cite:1] A route is a skill target plus a service. Every call to a peripheral needs a service. [cite:1] The routing client maps the label to busy, ring, an announcement, a scheduled target, or a trunk group and DNIS. Cited in this lab's ledger as retrieved 2026-10-14. The room marks part of this as re-check, so treat that part as unconfirmed.

Call Type Manager has a Script tab, a Period tab, and an optional Description. [cite:1] Run External Script, Play, Menu, Collect Data, or Queue before Send To VRU implies a Send To VRU for several VRU types. [cite:2] If Run External Script fails, test Call.VRUStatus. Cited in this lab's ledger as retrieved 2026-10-14. The room marks part of this as re-check, so treat that part as unconfirmed.

The VXML Server is a J2EE-compliant application server for dynamic VoiceXML applications. It can be installed without the Call Server. [cite:2] Standalone without reporting uses the VXML Server (Standalone) option. Standalone with reporting uses the VXML Server option and adds a Call Server and a Reporting Server. Cited in this lab's ledger as retrieved 2026-10-14. The room marks part of this as re-check, so treat that part as unconfirmed.

Finesse gadgets are applications inside one desktop. Third-party gadgets can live on the 3rdpartygadget web application or on an external server. [cite:1] REST calls from a gadget to an external service are proxied through Shindig. The gadget still has to authenticate to that third-party service itself. Cited in this lab's ledger as retrieved 2026-10-14. The room marks part of this as re-check, so treat that part as unconfirmed.

Transitional templates are the introductory stock set. All Fields templates expose database fields and are the base for custom reports, including precision-queue data. [cite:1] Import Outbound templates only when the deployment has Outbound Option. Cited in this lab's ledger as retrieved 2026-10-14. The room marks part of this as re-check, so treat that part as unconfirmed.

The private network carries synchronization and MDS traffic. The public network carries traffic between Central Controllers and PGs and is the alternate path that distinguishes a component failure from a network failure. Cited in this lab's ledger as retrieved 2026-10-14. The room marks part of this as re-check, so treat that part as unconfirmed.

Use the written Canon rooms for CVP, Finesse, CUIC, and sizing. Use this index to point the unwritten component, call-flow, and scripting topics at the chapter that already states them. [cite:1] [cite:2] The Router selects a peripheral or agent. The Logger stores configuration, real-time, and historical data. Cited in this lab's ledger as retrieved 2026-10-14. The room marks part of this as re-check, so treat that part as unconfirmed.

Equinix connectivity in the March 2022 note is a WAN to the Business Partner Network through ECX, in the U.S. and EMEA, with bandwidth from 200 MB to 10 GB. [cite:1] re-check VPN-less Finesse, same month, does not support FIPPA, and does not support multiple devices reaching the desktop through NAT. Cited in this lab's ledger as retrieved 2026-10-14. The room marks part of this as re-check, so treat that part as unconfirmed.

Knowledge Workers and Common Area devices captured in the First Time Setup Wizard determine how many call-processing nodes Cisco deploys. Sizing is a function of the Dedicated Instance team, not of the old on-premises cluster size. [cite:1] The first cluster in a region is activated within 48 hours. Cited in this lab's ledger as retrieved 2026-10-14. The room marks part of this as re-check, so treat that part as unconfirmed.

Dedicated Instance is an optional Webex Calling add-on. Activating a region is permanent, and the first voice service domain sticks. [cite:1] Activation deploys Unified CM, Unity Connection, Expressway Core and Edge, and Emergency Responder only in AMER. The access article also names IM and Presence and optional SME. Cited in this lab's ledger as retrieved 2026-10-14. The room marks part of this as re-check, so treat that part as unconfirmed.

Partner Connect addressing is a public /31 or /30 per physical link, four subnets per geo for Direct and four for Equinix Fabric, a public or private ASN, and a /16 per geo for partner management of the UC applications. Link subnets are not routed outside the service. Cited in this lab's ledger as retrieved 2026-10-14. The room marks part of this as re-check, so treat that part as unconfirmed.

R means the person doing the work. A signs off. C is two-way. I is one-way. [cite:1] Cisco is accountable and responsible for the core application build, core monitoring, and operational readiness testing before handover. [cite:1] A widespread issue is 100 percent of a UC cluster, or more than one cluster. Cited in this lab's ledger as retrieved 2026-10-14. The room marks part of this as re-check, so treat that part as unconfirmed.

If you need calls between the platforms, fold the preconfigured elements into both dial plans. [cite:1] Configure a PSTN connection on the default WXC-DI location before the main number. Until that number exists, users cannot make or receive calls through that route group. Cited in this lab's ledger as retrieved 2026-10-14. The room marks part of this as re-check, so treat that part as unconfirmed.

The practice article says roughly 95 percent of engineering effort is preparation and 5 percent is the change. That sentence is the article’s framing, not a sizing formula. [cite:1] The assistant tile is visible only when Setup Assist is enabled along with Dedicated Instance. Cited in this lab's ledger as retrieved 2026-10-14. The room marks part of this as re-check, so treat that part as unconfirmed.

Size trunks from concurrent calls. 2,000 seats is not 2,000 calls. [cite:2] Do not import ICM scripts. The crosswalk stays marked in T6-R04. [cite:4] Premises users cannot use cloud PSTN. [cite:3] WebRTC agents do not go live before 933. [cite:7] The runbook below is Canon planning. Cited in this lab's ledger as retrieved 2026-10-14.

The introduction says not to lift-and-shift Unified CM. Redefine requirements. The method is PPDIO: Prepare, Plan, Design, Implement, Optimize. [cite:1] Choose flash-cut or phased. Flash-cut moves everyone at once. The guides spend their detail on phased, because groups of users sit on both platforms during the move. Cited in this lab's ledger as retrieved 2026-10-14.

Migration Insights can run from any organization. You do not need the destination customer org to upload a Unified CM tar. [cite:2] Use SharedlineGroupMigrationReport.csv and HuntGroup_CallQueue_CallPark_CallPickUpGroups.csv to see who must move together. Cited in this lab's ledger as retrieved 2026-10-14. The room marks part of this as re-check, so treat that part as unconfirmed.

docs.ti: UCCE and PCCE to Webex Contact Center
docs.ex: Unified CCX has a discovery tool. The article says to download discovery tool v3.5, and the printed command runs uccx-to-webexcc-v3.4.jar . It writes WebexCC_Bulk_Upload.xlsx and a prompts zip. Bulk Operations in Control Hub imports the CSVs. The tool needs access to a Unified CCX server. Cited in this lab's ledger as retrieved 2026-10-14.

Migration Insights reads a Unified CM tar. A third-party PBX export is not that tar. [cite:2] [cite:5] The implement article says to work with the third-party vendor for third-party devices and phones. Cited in this lab's ledger as retrieved 2026-10-14. The room marks part of this as re-check, so treat that part as unconfirmed.

Slamming is forbidden. Cisco does not change a telephony provider without written consent of the authorized account holder. [cite:1] Same-account numbers port together even across orders. Distinct account information means separate orders. Toll-free is a separate order from DID, and the guidelines say US or CA only. Cited in this lab's ledger as retrieved 2026-10-14. The room marks part of this as re-check, so treat that part as unconfirmed.

A phased move splits users across Unified CM and Webex Calling. Each batch needs dial-plan updates on both platforms and on the Local Gateway. [cite:1] Put Webex Calling +E.164 patterns in their own partition. Cited in this lab's ledger as retrieved 2026-10-14. The room marks part of this as re-check, so treat that part as unconfirmed.

On-net tests cover transfer, hold, forwarding, and conferencing. PSTN tests cover inbound to users, queues, hunts, and auto attendants, plus outbound caller ID. [cite:1] Hunt tests check the configured algorithm, overflow, forwarding, no-answer, and that membership and routing match what was on Unified CM. Cited in this lab's ledger as retrieved 2026-10-14. The room marks part of this as re-check, so treat that part as unconfirmed.

The trunk to Webex Calling is SIP over TLS. Media is SRTP. Commercial gateways offer AES_CM_128_HMAC_SHA1_80. [cite:1] Registration trunks are CUBE only and stop at 250 calls. Certificate trunks go past 250 and need OPTIONS from the gateway FQDN. Cited in this lab's ledger as retrieved 2026-10-14.

jr1i3r’s voice class codec 100 allows G.711 only: preference 1 g711ulaw, preference 2 g711alaw. Add another codec only when both sides support it. DSP transcoding is supported and is not in that guide. Cited in this lab's ledger as retrieved 2026-10-14.

Media optimization uses ICE. Desk phones except DECT and ATA, the Webex App, and Local Gateway are the supported set. It is on by default for desk phones and the Webex App. [cite:1] Local Gateway uses ICE-lite. Minimum CUBE software in that article is 17.3 or 16.12.5. Cited in this lab's ledger as retrieved 2026-10-14. The room marks part of this as re-check, so treat that part as unconfirmed.

A route group holds at least one trunk and at most ten. Same priority is random load balancing. A lower priority is used when the higher-priority trunks are unavailable. [cite:1] Trunk status is online, offline, impaired, or unknown. The page updates every 3 minutes. Cited in this lab's ledger as retrieved 2026-10-14.

Skill-based selection filters agents who entirely satisfy the contact or the queue, then applies the pattern. Weights change Best Available scoring. They do not change Longest Available. [cite:1] Non-skill Longest Available picks the agent available longest since their last contact. Cited in this lab's ledger as retrieved 2026-10-14.

upg0eu, dated August 30, 2024, compares Auto Attendant, Call Queue, Hunt Group, and Shared Line Group. Only the call queue adds callers to a queue. Only the auto attendant provides IVR. A call queue and a hunt group say an auto attendant can be used as the IVR. Cited in this lab's ledger as retrieved 2026-10-14. The room marks part of this as re-check, so treat that part as unconfirmed.

A dial plan is global for the enterprise. It chooses a trunk or a route group for matching patterns, for every user, regardless of location. [cite:1] If the caller is still a premises user, stop. Cloud PSTN will not take that call. Give them a premises path or move the user. Cited in this lab's ledger as retrieved 2026-10-14.

Flow Designer routes real-time calls. You choose activities, including how agents are assigned, from a drag-and-drop library. [cite:1] Start Flow is already on the main canvas. You cannot delete it. It is the event that triggers the flow. [cite:1] Validation is off by default, so errors stay hidden. Cited in this lab's ledger as retrieved 2026-10-14.

Courtesy callback creates a queue task. Keep the original queue if the contact should hold its place. Move it only when you accept the end of the new queue, no skills, and default priority. [cite:2] Scheduled callback is a future window. Configure the Callback Default Entry Point first. Cited in this lab's ledger as retrieved 2026-10-14.

Connect’s own page lists six areas: channel provisioning, integration setup, flow orchestration, multichannel messaging, NLP/NLU/AI, and enterprise control. Channels include SMS, RCS, Branded Text, WhatsApp, Push, Live Chat and In-App, Email, Voice, MMS, Apple Messages for Business, and Messenger. Cited in this lab's ledger as retrieved 2026-10-14.

Each connector launches Desktop inside the CRM. You do not create a new Webex App for the install. [cite:1] [cite:2] [cite:3] Chat and email stay on Connect and the digital desktop. The connector articles say those channels are unsupported here, for every CRM that uses these connectors. Cited in this lab's ledger as retrieved 2026-10-14.

AI Assistant is a paid desktop add-on with an icon. Header on nvvv1zb: October 06, 2026.
